notes: A no is a complete answer here and costs nothing to act on.
If the answer is yes, the frequency matters more than the mechanism: a game that stages an assassination every few years is making a claim about the United States that is not true.
question: The game has a complete record type for an attempt of violence against a public figure, with an outcome, and nothing in play can write one. Before any rate is discussed: (1) should this occur in the game at all, and to whom — a president in the background, a governor, a member of a state legislature, the player; (2) if it should, what is a defensible frequency, given that the honest real-world figure for an American officeholder is very small and a game that fires it often is asserting something false about the country; (3) what should the world do afterwards, given that a succession-at-death path already exists and works; (4) should the player ever be the subject, and should the game let a player be the actor, which is a product and content decision rather than an empirical one; and (5) what should a player be shown — the game's press surface would carry it, and the tone of that coverage is a decision somebody has to make on purpose.

sourcesChecked.source: src/simulation/crisis/international.ts and the officeholder-death path measured over two years of one save
sourcesChecked.whatItDidNotSettle: Establishes that the writer exists, is unreachable, and that the consequences of a public figure dying are already built and exercised — 17 officeholders died in office in one two-year run. It settles that the aftermath is not the hard part. It says nothing about whether this should happen or how often.

title: Whether political violence should happen in this game at all, and on what terms
usableAnswer: First a yes or no with reasoning. If yes: who may be a subject, a frequency with a source, what happens to the world afterwards, and a clear line on the player as subject and as actor. If no: say so, and the record retires rather than waits.
whyItMatters: Measured 2026-09-22 at main 62368c1e. WHAT EXISTS: recordViolenceAttempt in crisis/international.ts, and a working succession path off the SSA 2023 life table that already handles an officeholder dying. THE ONE MISSING LINK: recordViolenceAttempt has zero callers outside tests. THE SMALLEST HONEST CHANGE: whatever the answer is, it is small — either delete the writer, or call it from one producer at an authored rate. WHAT A PLAYER WOULD SEE: depends entirely on the answer, which is why this is a decision and not an engineering task. The owner named assassination himself as something he wanted to understand, which is why it is asked rather than quietly dropped.
